faq.q: How many wanted stars does Grand Theft Auto VI have?
faq.a: Six. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson confirmed to press after the August 2026 previews that the wanted system returns to a six-star maximum, up from GTA V's five-star cap.

faq.q: Is the six-star system the same as older GTA games?
faq.a: It returns to a maximum last seen in earlier era GTA titles, replacing GTA V's five stars. The record does not detail exactly how star-by-star behavior compares to those older games.

faq.q: What happens at six stars in GTA 6?
faq.a: Six stars is described as producing a high-chaos, heavily armed police response, while one star is described as easy to shake, showing a wide gap in intensity across the scale.

faq.q: Where was the GTA 6 wanted system shown?
faq.a: The system was demonstrated during the 27 August 2026 Extended Look and detailed further in hands-off preview sessions Rockstar gave to outlets including IGN and GamesRadar in late August 2026.

faq.q: How does the six-star system relate to the new police profile system in GTA VI?
faq.a: The record lists the Police Criminal Profile System as a related entity, suggesting the two work together, though it does not spell out the exact mechanical link between star escalation and evidence tracking.

notKnown: The exact police response behavior at each of the six star levels
How the star system interacts mechanically with the Police Criminal Profile System
Whether the six-star cap can be exceeded through special story or mission scenarios
howWeKnow: This was confirmed by Rockstar North's Rob Nelson in press interviews following the 27 August 2026 Extended Look, and reported by GamesRadar on 28 August 2026 based on hands-off preview sessions given to outlets including IGN. It is treated here as major press coverage of a developer statement, not a formal Rockstar publication.
